entities.name: Vincenzo Dall'Osso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincenzo Dall'Osso was an Italian boxer. He competed in the men's bantamweight event at the 1952 Summer Olympics. In 1951 he won the European Amateur Boxing Championships in Milan.
